notes.title: Steam Sale! Celebrating the release of The Crooked Man!
notes.notes:
Today we have released "The Crooked Man" developed by Uri Games, the first installment in "The Strange Man" series. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/736570/The_Crooked_Man/

We are also planning to release the other titles in this series. 

To celebrate the launch of this title, we have set some fantastic 2D pixel games from Playism on sale! So please enjoy them all together. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/352810/Yukie_A_Japanese_Winter_Fairy_Tale/

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Yukie Update: 19/07/2017
notes.notes:
Hi  All

We have updated Yukie to deal with the issue of Save files being left in the English build. 
Please note that in order for Steam to not delete everyone's save files until now, the latest build now contains the chapter 1 save file, but your save data will be preserved as is.
For those who still have the debug save files, please delete or overwrite them. Sorry for inconvenience.

We have also enabled cloud saves, so the game will save to cloud when you open and close the game.

Thank you for your understanding and we hope you keep enjoying the game.
